import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the cblas_cgemm function
# Correcting the issue: cblas_cgemm is part of libgslcblas.so, not libgsl.so
cblas_cgemm = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so").cblas_cgemm
cblas_cgemm.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int,
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int,
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int
]

# Constants for CBLAS_ORDER and CBLAS_TRANSPOSE
gsl.CblasRowMajor = 101
gsl.CblasColMajor = 102
gsl.CblasNoTrans = 111
gsl.CblasTrans = 112
gsl.CblasConjTrans = 113

def matrix_multiply(order, transA, transB, M, N, K, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, C, ldc):
    alpha_c = np.array([alpha.real, alpha.imag], dtype=np.float32)
    beta_c = np.array([beta.real, beta.imag], dtype=np.float32)
    A_c = np.array(A, dtype=np.complex64).view(np.float32).flatten()
    B_c = np.array(B, dtype=np.complex64).view(np.float32).flatten()
    C_c = np.array(C, dtype=np.complex64).view(np.float32).flatten()

    cblas_cgemm(
        order, transA, transB, M, N, K,
        alpha_c.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),
        A_c.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), lda,
        B_c.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ldb,
        beta_c.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),
        C_c.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ldc
    )

    return C_c.view(np.complex64).reshape((M, N))

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple 2x2 matrix multiplication
    A = np.array([[1+2j, 2+3j], [3+4j, 4+5j]], dtype=np.complex64)
    B = np.array([[5+6j, 6+7j], [7+8j, 8+9j]], dtype=np.complex64)
    C = np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.complex64)
    alpha = 1+0j
    beta = 0+0j
    result = matrix_multiply(gsl.CblasRowMajor, gsl.CblasNoTrans, gsl.CblasNoTrans, 2, 2, 2, alpha, A, 2, B, 2, beta, C, 2)
    expected = np.dot(A, B)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 2: Identity matrix multiplication
    A = np.eye(2, dtype=np.complex64)
    B = np.array([[1+1j, 0], [0, 1+1j]], dtype=np.complex64)
    C = np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.complex64)
    alpha = 1+0j
    beta = 0+0j
    result = matrix_multiply(gsl.CblasRowMajor, gsl.CblasNoTrans, gsl.CblasNoTrans, 2, 2, 2, alpha, A, 2, B, 2, beta, C, 2)
    expected = B
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 3: Zero matrix multiplication
    A = np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.complex64)
    B = np.array([[1+1j, 2+2j], [3+3j, 4+4j]], dtype=np.complex64)
    C = np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.complex64)
    alpha = 1+0j
    beta = 0+0j
    result = matrix_multiply(gsl.CblasRowMajor, gsl.CblasNoTrans, gsl.CblasNoTrans, 2, 2, 2, alpha, A, 2, B, 2, beta, C, 2)
    expected = np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.complex64)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 3 failed: {result} != {expected}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
